system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
I have troubles saving data to SD card on android. Reinstalling, changing settings, remounting, clearing cache ... nothing works. There is quite a lot of people with the same issue. Do you have any solutions to this?

PREDICTED INTENT: app_crash_performance

PRECEDENTS:

[1457849] (similarity 0.52, intent app_crash_performance)
  past customer: i think its my phone . out of nowhere today sd card corrupted. Nothin with your app sorry!!
  spotify replied: No worries! Let us know if you ever need us again. We'd be... <link>

[802604] (similarity 0.51, intent app_crash_performance)
  past customer: your android app has gradually got worse. Have to wipe cache daily to get it to stop freezing
  spotify replied: Hey Duane! That doesn't sound good. What device (make and model), Android and Spotify version are you using?

[831460] (similarity 0.48, intent app_crash_performance)
  past customer: everytime I try and share anything on Android, it crashes/closes the app. I tried reinstalling, but nothing! Any advice?
  spotify replied: Hey Adam! Thanks for the heads-up. Could you confirm the make/model, Android and Spotify versions of your device?

[1353058] (similarity 0.48, intent app_crash_performance)
  past customer: Having problems with offline mode on my Honor 7. When I use my SD card for storage after every restart all downloads are gone!
  spotify replied: Hi there. Can you let us know what Android and Spotify version are you running? Also, how much space do you have left on your SD card?

[1691154] (similarity 0.46, intent app_crash_performance)
  past customer: isn't working and I️ never save music to my phone <link>
  spotify replied: Hi, that doesn't sound good! Can you let us know your phone's make/model, operating system, and Spotify version?

Draft the reply as JSON.
